totals.assertion_scope: 23 per case includes target identity, stopped/playing refusals, finite runtime data, measured physical effects/timing, preflight clock preservation, reinitialization and four source-file hashes. Not230 independent motion experiments.

effects: Runtime mass/velocity/quaternion and named articulation DOFs are finite on the selected PhysX engine, with no USD fallback.
Original fixture falls from z3 onto the known floor;Elbow reaches+.2 and-.2radians and the arm world pose moves.
1,12,60,120,120,12 requested steps measure their expected120Hz simulation intervals; no rendered-frame claim.
Stopped/playing,bounded-input,missing-path,stale-target andjoint-limit requests refuse. Invalid paused preflights do not advance the observed clock.
Explicit Stop then Play/Pause permits another finite measured12-step observation in the same stage/session. Four original project fixture file hashes unchanged.
limitations: Original20f6.0.1W108-step stall remains unresolved; this smaller fixture is not a reproduction or remedy of that full-scene failure.
Existing Newton failures/scoped6.2 successes remain experimental limitations; this PhysX work establishes no Newton recovery or all6.2 Newton support.
Latest1f clipping fixture files were previously reopened standaloneUSD, not freshKit reuse. No camera creation/capture was used in this fixture.
Prepared older environments and locked cached6.2 environment with upload-disabled diagnostic bootstrap; no clean-machine/full-installer or executed Lab locked-replay qualification.

First62H client attempt stopped before Play because its error parser did not unwrap MCP error text. v2 recreated the stopped stage in the same owned process. All other qualified cases used fresh processes.

One61 launch refused port reuse while TCP was TIME_WAIT; a6000 launch refused ROSdomain232 outside0..231. Corrected private driver used distinct ports and valid domains; guards unchanged, no Kit started for either refusal.
First62W Console click lacked dimensions and schema refused it before input. Explicit observed1440x900 dimensions then succeeded.

Five actual window Console reviews show0errors with nonzero startup/USD/bridge-client-close warnings. UI counters differ from native-line counts and are not merged. No suppression or general harmlessness claim.

Three actual stills per window were reviewed, with wide framing and no video. Numerical MCP readbacks establish physics effects; screenshots do not. Images remain private, only original hashes/review records distributed.
No newly independent natural-language agent task was run for this regression. Existing agent tasks keep their original heads and scoped outcomes.
All ten owned PIDs exited normally via managedSIGINT and were confirmed absent; no user process terminated. No product code changed. PR16 remains draft/unmerged; release unpublished.
